Attending	Marcus Feldstein, M.D., Trauma Surgery
Consults	Neurology (Reyes-Okafor), Orthopaedics (Voss)
HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
46-year-old male, restrained driver, rear-ended on I-91 by a commercial truck. Brief LOC at scene.
Employed as a forklift operator at a warehouse in North Haven.
IMAGING
CT head: no intracranial hemorrhage. X-ray left clavicle: midshaft fracture, displaced 1 cm. MRI lumbar
spine 01/10/2026: broad-based disc bulge L4-L5 without nerve root compression. X-ray bilateral knees:
no fracture.

with L4-L5 disc bulge. 4. Scalp laceration, 6 cm, repaired with 9 sutures. 5. Bilateral knee contusions.
DISCHARGE PLAN
Sling for left arm. No lifting over 5 lb. Suture removal in 10 days. Follow up Shoreline Orthopaedics 1
week, New Haven Neurology Group 2 weeks. Out of work until cleared.
